svg.title: In five of the seven countries we selected the rise in current dollars is larger than the rise in volume; in two it is the reverse
svg.desc: Table: In five of the seven countries we selected the rise in current dollars is larger than the rise in volume; in two it is the reverse: Current dollars: World: 308%, Türkiye: 582%, Germany: 232%, India: 1,261%, South Korea: 324%, Brazil: 485%, United States: 193%, Japan: 77%; Volume: World: 133%, Türkiye: 285%, Germany: 115%, India: 702%, South Korea: 347%, Brazil: 169%, United States: 99%, Japan: 116%.
